hooks.command: unset VIRTUAL_ENV; export PYTHONWARNINGS=ignore::SyntaxWarning; export TYPEDB_PORT="${TYPEDB_PORT:-1730}"; export TYPEDB_DATABASE="${TYPEDB_DATABASE:-mythras}"; GM="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/mythras-gm"; CORE=$(find ~/.claude/plugins/cache -path '*/alhazen-core/*/alhazen_core.py' 2>/dev/null | head -1); [ -z "$CORE" ] && [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../alhazen-core/alhazen_core.py" ] && CORE="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../alhazen-core/alhazen_core.py"; [ -z "$CORE" ] && [ -f "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/skills/alhazen-core/alhazen_core.py" ] && CORE="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/skills/alhazen-core/alhazen_core.py"; if [ -z "$CORE" ]; then   echo "mythras-gm: alhazen-core not found, so TypeDB was not initialised. The game CANNOT run until it is: /plugin install alhazen-core@skillful-alhazen. Do not start a session expecting state to persist."; exit 0; fi; CORE_DIR=$(dirname "$CORE"); if ! uv run --project "$CORE_DIR" python "$CORE" init >/dev/null 2>&1; then   echo "mythras-gm: TypeDB init failed for database $TYPEDB_DATABASE. Is the container up? (docker compose up -d, from the mythras-gm repo). The game CANNOT run until this succeeds."; exit 0; fi; if ! uv run --project "$CORE_DIR" python "$CORE" load-schema "$GM/schema.tql" >/dev/null 2>&1; then   echo "mythras-gm: schema load failed into $TYPEDB_DATABASE. The game CANNOT run."; exit 0; fi; uv run --project "$GM" python "$GM/mythras_gm.py" load-rules >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "mythras-gm: rules graph failed to load; query-rules will return nothing."
